limits: Local Python 3.12/Windows audit, not all-target certification or new-API testing.
Directory ordinal is czifile file-directory order, not certified future SubblockInfo.index or opaque level tokens.
Embedded Application fields are producer clues, not proof of original acquisition/generation or privacy clearance.
Only one existing NPZ pairing is independently checked; no global admission/reference state is promoted.
No original CZI/NPZ/NPY/TXT bytes changed; canonical manifest remains 34 byte streams/49 paths.

Generators are local exploratory scripts; commands require a fresh output directory and refuse overwrites. The copied evidence and source hashes are pinned; a portable CI fixture-generation workflow is not delivered here.

generation.recipe: uint16 YXA[32,48,1], value[y,x,0] = 257*y + 11*x; expected NPZ saved before any CZI write; T/C/Z = 0, scene = 0, location = (0,0)
generation.expected_values: Literal inputs, not extracted from the reader under test
generation.reproducibility: Deterministic pixels and coordinates; native-writer GUIDs may vary between generations. Materialized byte identities are pinned below.
generation.admission: private candidates, not added to the redistributable fixture manifest

compression.axis_alignment: CZI YX equals literal YX; saved NPZ has one trailing component
compression.limits: Private candidates, not corpus admission or new-API tests. Decoder uses imagecodecs Zstd, not libCZI; Zstd implementations share the compression format/library family. Negative errors are observed czifile errors, not certification of future pylibCZIrw errors.

levels.recipe: two raw Gray16 tiles at (0,0), T/C/Z/S=0; base YX[32,48]=257*y+11*x; lower YX[16,24]=40000+101*y+7*x; native writer assigns M automatically; structural mutations prepared separately
levels.mutation: bounded DV global/inline X/Y logical/stored sizes, observed pyramid type, and raw M start; no explicit-M writer API
levels.limits: Private synthetic candidates. Future M-selection/stored-level APIs and error contracts are not implemented or certified by this structural/pixel check.

masks_and_attachments.recipe: bounded appended native-format segments on the private literal Gray16 template; fixed attachment GUIDs and literal payloads; known mask[y,x]=(y+x)%3!=0

corrupt_mask.observed_czifile_result: None (tolerated corruption); future API error is not certified

masks_and_attachments.limits: Private bounded candidates, not corpus admission, public writer features or new-API pass. Corrupt-mask validation is structural because czifile tolerates invalid chunks. No original fixture, private metadata value or baseline environment changed.

final_mask_repair.repair: add required METADATA/AttachmentSchema/DataFormat=CHUNKCONTAINER; unchanged literal pixels and mask bits

jpegxr.limits: Czifile does not call libCZI, but JPEG-XR codec implementations may share the Microsoft reference-code family; literal inputs, not another decoder's output, define expectations.

irregular.stored_pixels: exact literal reduced array; future composition rejection remains implementation work

xml.recipe: bounded relocated subblock on private literal Gray16 template; exact known UTF8/empty bytes; structured XML serialization for the unknown element
xml.limits: Private candidates. Czifile preserves raw valid UTF8 without requiring well-formed XML; no future pylibCZIrw API/error contract is certified.
